2607.28858.title: A Unified Benchmark of Deep Learning Models for Multi-task 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging
2607.28858.paper_summary: Automatic brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has become a fundamental task in computer-assisted diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. Although numerous deep learning architectures have recently been proposed, objective comparisons remain challenging because published studies often employ different datasets, preprocessing strategies, training protocols, and evaluation procedures. This work presents a unified experimental benchmark for comparing representative convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformer-based models, and recent State Space Model (SSM) architectures under homogeneous experimental conditions. Five state-of-the-art three-dimensional segmentation models, including 3D U-Net, SegResNet, Swin UNETR, SegMamba, and SegMambaV2, are evaluated on two brain tumor segmentation datasets representing distinct clinical scenarios: intracranial meningioma segmentation (BraTS 2023) and post-treatment glioma segmentation (BraTS 2024). All architectures are trained using identical preprocessing, data augmentation, optimization strategies, and evaluation protocols to ensure a fair comparison. Performance is assessed using segmentation accuracy metrics together with computational cost indicators, including inference time and the size of each model. The results provide practical insights into the trade-offs between segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting the suitability of different architectural paradigms for challenging three-dimensional brain tumor segmentation tasks.
2607.28858.paper_summary_zh: 自動化腦腫瘤分割從磁共振成像（MRI）已成為計算機輔助診斷、治療計劃和疾病監測中的基本任務。儘管最近提出了許多深度學習架構，但由於已發表的研究通常使用不同的數據集、預處理策略、訓練協議和評估程序，因此客觀比較仍然具有挑戰性。本研究提出了一個統一的實驗基準，用於在同質實驗條件下比較代表性的卷積神經網絡（CNN）、基於Transformer的模型和最近的狀態空間模型（SSM）架構。五個最先進的三維分割模型，包括3D U-Net、SegResNet、Swin UNETR、SegMamba和SegMambaV2，將在代表不同臨床場景的兩個腦腫瘤分割數據集上進行評估：顱內腦膜瘤分割（BraTS 2023）和治療後膠質瘤分割（BraTS 2024）。所有架構均使用相同的預處理、數據增強、優化策略和評估協議進行訓練，以確保公平比較。性能評估使用分割準確性指標以及計算成本指標，包括推理時間和每個模型的大小。結果提供了有關分割準確性和計算效率之間權衡的實用見解，突顯了不同架構範式在挑戰性三維腦腫瘤分割任務中的適用性。
